messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — I pushed a TF change to switch the model-serv Deployment strategy to RollingUpdate with maxSurge=0 and maxUnavailable=1. Want a quick sanity check before CI runs.

kai: Why zero surge? are we trying to avoid double GPU allocation? :thinking:

morgan: Yeah, cost + PV/detach ordering. We mount per-model PVs so we want at most N pods active to avoid double-mounts.

rachel: If you mount PVs, plain rolling update with 0 surge can stall if pods take time to detach. Have you considered a small canary partition first?

andre: Also: HPA is enabled (CPU based). With maxSurge=0, the controller can't create extra pods during rollout so HPA + rollout might fight each other. Could see transient underprovisioning.

morgan: Good point — current TF sets min_replicas = 2. I'm planning to bump to 3 in the patch. Snippet from the change: ```resource "kubernetes_deployment" "model_serv" { spec { replicas = var.replicas strategy { rolling_update { max_surge = 0 max_unavailable = 1 } } } }```

kai: Terraform plan shows a replacement for the deployment when strategy fields change (it wants to recreate). Did you get that?

morgan: Yup, plan shows "forces replacement". I want to avoid downtime. Any safe in-place approach?

rachel: We have two options: 1) do a controlled manual in-cluster patch (kubectl) for strategy to avoid TF replacement, then reconcile state later, or 2) change strategy to maxSurge=1 for canary, run canary, then switch to final config in a follow-up commit. Option 2 is safer for TF workflows.

andre: For secrets rotation (we're rotating model creds next week) ensure the initContainer that fetches the model artifact runs reliably. We previously saw an init failure -> CrashLoop and the rollout stalled because readiness never became true.

morgan: The initContainer reads MODEL_KEY_PATH from a k8s secret that will be rotated. Any recs to make rotation safe?

kai: Make readiness depend on model file existence and health probe instead of liveness only. Add a small timeout backoff in the init job so it retries fetching creds a few times before failing the pod. Also consider tagging the secret with a version and letting init fetch latest stable version.

rachel: Also add a preStop hook to the app container to wait for in-flight requests to drain (sleep 5s or call graceful API). That reduces risk during eviction.

andre: Regarding TF, if changing strategy forces replacement, `create_before_destroy` isn't applicable for Deployments. A safer pattern: increment the replica count, use maxSurge=1 temporarily, then scale down old pods after new ones are ready. Document a manual rollout checklist in the PR.

morgan: Plan: update TF to replicas=3 and strategy.maxSurge=1 for the canary commit. Include a PR checklist: (1) schedule rollout window, (2) rotate secret in staging, (3) run controlled canary, (4) switch to final config (maxSurge=0) if all good. I'll push a WIP PR and ping for review.

deploy-bot: CI triggered for PR #4821 — terraform plan started.

andre: Quick ops note: tag the PR with `ops/rollout-window` if you need a quiet deploy window (we prefer 2–4am unless there's exec time).

morgan: Will do. ETA pushing the PR in ~30m, thanks for the quick checks.
